artworks.title: The Infant in the Gallery
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene with classical elements. The image features a circular composition depicting a grand architectural structure reminiscent of ancient Roman or Greek design. The scene includes rows of ornate columns with intricate capitals supporting an entablature adorned with decorative motifs. The perspective leads the eye into the background, revealing additional classical buildings and structures. On the floor, there is a sculptural figure, possibly representing a mythological character, seated among scattered architectural pieces, including sections resembling broken columns. The lines and patterns emphasize depth, showcasing architectural rendering and attention to detail. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings.

artworks.title: The Big Cedar
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. A large tree dominates the right side of the image, with branches extending outward. A fence is in the foreground. A line of distant trees marks the horizon in the middle of the image. Beyond the tree and fence, a horse-drawn cart loaded with hay and a small farm building are visible. The artwork features fine and detailed brushwork capturing textures. The color palette is monochrome sepia.

artworks.title: The Broad Curtain
artworks.description: The image shows a part of a person's body in a cushioned chair, engrossed in a book or magazine. The person sits in a relaxed position, with dark hair and light-colored clothing. A table with a tall plant and a decorative object is beside them. The background includes large windows with sheer curtains, a wall, and a hanging picture frame.

artworks.title: Saint George on Horseback Slaying the Dragon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.6 x 15.4 cm (8 7/8 x 6 1/16 in.)

artworks.title: Deer Hunt (La chasse au cerf)
artworks.description: The image shows a body of water with a dark, wooded area under a transitioning sky. Trees create a low skyline. The lithograph technique produces fine brushstrokes for a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and grey creating contrasts and forms in the scene. There are faint animal forms, possibly horses, in the distance.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.description: The image is a landscape drawing showing rugged mountains with a castle on cliffs, a winding river, detailed trees, a bridge with people crossing it, and a monochromatic color palette of varying brown shades.

artworks.title: David and Goliath
artworks.medium: etching//conjoining subject on 2 sheets of paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures on a battlefield. In the foreground, an armored figure stands with a spear and shield, looking left. To the right, a smaller figure holds a sling. In the background, there is a hillside with buildings and tents, and lines suggesting the sun.

artworks.title: Seated Magician with Other Figures beside an Altar
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a natural setting. The central figure is seated, with a full beard and hair covered by a cloth. He wears a tunic with ornamentation and a cloak. Next to him stands a second man, shirtless and holding a staff. There are objects around them - a large vase, an owl, and a cow skull. The background shows outdoor scenery with bare trees. The ground is uneven.

artworks.title: Saint Peter Walking on the Water
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a ship and figures interacting on a turbulent sea. The drawing shows two figures in the foreground surrounded by waves. One figure is leaning toward the other, pointing emphatically while holding the other's hand. In the background, a ship with an intricately designed hull and sails is seen, with several figures aboard. The waves are depicted with energetic and swirling lines. The sky has stylized clouds. The drawing also features detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Saint Bridget
artworks.medium: woodcut, hand-colored in gray, brown, green, yellow, carmine, and red
artworks.description: The image features a central seated figure wearing a hooded robe, holding open books. Surrounding this central figure are smaller figures in robes, some with halos and red headdresses. Above the central figure is an archway with decorative elements, including two crowned children and a dove. The background includes scrolls and floral motifs, all within a bordered frame with text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a set of playing cards with figures on horseback. The artwork consists of three individual frames, each depicting a horse and rider holding different objects: a club, a decorated disk, and a chalice. The riders are dressed in tunics, and the horses are adorned with minimalistic tack. The figures are outlined with simple lines against a plain background. Each card is framed by a rectangular border with slightly rounded corners, and the drawing is rendered on cream-colored paper with aged edges.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.description: The image shows playing card designs with figures in medieval attire and motifs. The drawing is divided into multiple rectangular sections, each featuring a figure representing elements commonly found in a deck of cards, such as kings or knights. The figures are depicted with attributes hinting at royalty or nobility, seated on ornate thrones or standing with regal posture, holding items like swords or scepters. The drawing has a style reminiscent of early European woodcuts, with simplified lines and a focus on decorative details. The figures are drawn with hatching to suggest depth and texture, in a linear fashion. The overall aesthetic is medieval, focusing on costume details typical of a historical or legendary context.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.description: The image shows a grid with rectangular and circular shapes. The rectangular sections display repetitive patterns resembling ornate candlesticks or chess pieces, while the circular sections contain motifs similar to rosettes or floral emblems. The arrangement of the forms creates a sense of rhythm and pattern, reminiscent of decorative tiles or playing cards.

artworks.title: Playing Cards
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grid composed of various ornate symbols and designs. The drawing features a series of rectangular sections, each containing different linear designs. The prominent design in the top section includes crossed staffs or rods with decorative caps on each end. Adjacent to it is an image of a hand holding a bundle of rods adorned with symbols. The lower portion of the composition showcases circular patterns interwoven with geometric details. The entire composition is rendered on aged, lightly stained paper.

artworks.title: Knight and Lady
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, a man and a woman, in a detailed etching. The man is seated on the left, while the woman is on the right. The man has curly hair and a full beard, wearing intricate clothing. The woman has long hair with braids and wears a detailed dress. In the background, there is a castle, trees, and a water feature. The scene is intricately carved, with foliage in the foreground and a dog at the woman's feet.

artworks.title: Poesia (Poetry)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure playing a flute. The person is seated in a reclining position and shown from head to feet. They hold the flute to their lips, with their head turned slightly to the right. The person's facial features appear detailed, with calm eyes and a serene expression. They have long hair parted in the middle that flows down past their shoulders. The person wears a flowing robe with long sleeves, suggesting movement. Behind them is a decorated urn with a twisted stem and floral motifs. In the lower part of the image, a celestial globe decorated with stars is visible, in front of stylized hills. The scene is framed with a simple border.

artworks.title: Cherub on a Vase with Inscription: "SOLI DEO HONOR"
artworks.artist: Francesco Francia or Peregrino da Cesena
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 5 x 2 cm (1 15/16 x 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a cherubic figure, likely representing Cupid, standing in a dynamic pose with one leg raised and the other extended behind. The figure has a youthful face, short wavy hair, and is mostly unclothed with wings on its back. The background includes a banner with the inscription "H. O. D." and a decorative textured backdrop with a rounded base beneath the figure's feet.

artworks.title: Saint Christopher
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a male figure in a seated position on rocks. The man is looking over his shoulder with a focused expression. He has a prominent nose, a beard, and a balding head with curly hair on the sides. He is wearing an ornamented garment with a tunic, puffed sleeves, and boots. He holds a staff in his right hand and a book in his left hand. A winged cherubic figure is above him, holding a framed object. Various small items are scattered on the ground around him. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Sebaldus
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man standing in a frontal pose within an ornate architectural setting. He wears a detailed robe with fur trim and a tall hat with an emblem. He has long hair, a thick beard, and a fur collar. He holds a model of a cathedral in his left hand and a staff with beads in his right hand. The background features columns, an arch, heraldic shields, and a halo-like circle behind his head.

artworks.title: Henry IV, King of France
artworks.dimensions:
overall size: 12 x 9.2 cm (4 3/4 x 3 5/8 in.)
sheet: 14.2 x 11.1 cm (5 9/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. The man is facing slightly to the right with his head turned towards the viewer. He has defined facial features, including a long nose and a small, pointed beard, with curly hair visible from under a large, feathered hat. The man is wearing a high-collared garment with intricate detailing, suggesting a formal outfit typical of historical attire. The background is plain, with text wrapped around the oval frame indicating the name and title, "HENRICUS 4 D G REX FRAN. ET NAVARRÆ ÆTATIS 49 1601," which identifies him as Henry IV of France.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 16.2 x 11.2 cm (6 3/8 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: An intricately detailed etching viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. Two figures dressed in traditional attire, one standing holding a viola and the other seated playing bagpipes. A tree with full branches on the right, and a path leading to a wooden building in the distance on the left. In the background, a slightly lower horizon. The etching shows fine, meticulous lines to create details and textures, with a monochromatic color palette focusing on black and white contrasts.

artworks.title: The First Oriental Head
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn after Jan Lievens
artworks.description: The etching depicts the upper portion of a man's body, mostly from the shoulders up. The man is positioned facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. He has a weathered face with deep wrinkles and prominent cheekbones. His expression appears contemplative. His hair is short and sparse on top, with a slight fringe on his forehead. He wears a cloak with a fur collar, buttoned at the front, and a beaded chain hangs around his neck. The background is simple, composed of cross-hatched lines and a plain, textured surface that accentuates the figure. Above the man's head, the etching is signed with "Rembrandt. Perrettus" and the year "1635" handwritten in a cursive style.

artworks.title: The Small Madonna and Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing, holding a child in her arms. The woman has long, wavy hair and wears draped clothing. The child has curly hair and a light halo over their head. The background is plain, with inscribed letters at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Good Samaritan (Le Bon Samaritain)
artworks.description: The image displays a densely wooded area with intricate details. In the center, a camel is resting while a traveler sits close by. In the distance, the horizon is visible beyond the thick trees and foliage, continuing the lush landscape. The artwork uses detailed brushstrokes to create texture, bringing each element to life. The grayscale palette adds a sense of timelessness and depth to the scene. The vegetation is abundant and varied, with different grasses and plants. Tall trees form a dense canopy against the cloudy sky above.
